sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Literacy workbook (lessons 11-16 + review). PDF p. 3 'Alfabeto mixteco de San Antonio Sinicahua' with 'Notas sobre este alfabeto': d only in Spanish loans and the pronouns maa da/maa de; r has two pronunciations written by Spanish rules (rii 'borrego' vs. maa ro 'tú'); f, g, l, p mostly in loans; saltillo; a separate 'Nota: Nasalización' (final -n marks nasal vowels: tajan, vijin, yukan). Tone is not written and never mentioned; nothing on stress/accent (a full-text search for stress/accent tono/acento/sílaba = 0).
